chunks: Objection: When Allah comes to know that we are prepared to obey him, He would create him. Like according to your belief He will manifest him during his reappearance?

Reply: The imperativeness of supporting him and determination to obey him is required in all conditions, which requires that to support and obey him and to follow his path should be possible in all conditions, or else, imposing this duty would be wrong. The suggestion would be relevant if we were not obliged in all conditions to his obedience and submission to his command and rather it were required of us at the time of his appearance. However, the reality is contrary to this.
ai.seo_question: Why is the Imam not manifested immediately if God knows we are ready to support him?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi addresses the theological challenge of divine justice (Adl) during the Imam's occultation, arguing that the obligation of obedience is perpetual rather than contingent on the Imam's physical presence. This ensures that the command to obey remains meaningful and just, as the capacity for compliance is always inherent in the believer's state, preventing the charge of 'unjustified burden' (Taklif ma la yutiq).
